name: Securities Trade Status Reason
definition: Specifies the underlying reason for a status of a securities trade.

DeniedReason.name: Denied Reason
DeniedReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the request was denied.

GeneratedReason.name: Generated Reason
GeneratedReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the transaction was generated.

AllegementReason.name: Allegement Reason
AllegementReason.definition: Reason why the instruction has an allegement status.

PendingSettlementReason.name: Pending Settlement Reason
PendingSettlementReason.definition: Reason for the settlement pending status.

RepoCallAcknowledgementReason.name: Repo Call Acknowledgement Reason
RepoCallAcknowledgementReason.definition: Specifies additional information about the processed instruction.

RepairReason.name: Repair Reason
RepairReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction/request has a repair status.

DeliveryReturnReason.name: Delivery Return Reason
DeliveryReturnReason.definition: Reason why the trade was returned.

CounterpartyStatusReason.name: Counterparty Status Reason
CounterpartyStatusReason.definition: Specifies the counterparty action which is the reason of the trade status.

ModifiedStatusReason.name: Modified Status Reason
ModifiedStatusReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the related instruction is modified.

SecuritiesTradeStatus.name: Securities Trade Status
SecuritiesTradeStatus.definition: Status for which a reason is provided. It is derived from the association between StatusReason and Status.
